# dist/ — generated files

Do not edit these by hand. Rebuild with:

    node tools/build-single.js

- **englishactivities.html** — the whole app inlined into one file. Email it to
  a student, put it on a USB stick, open it offline. No server, no other files.
- **artifact-body.html** — the same page as a body-only fragment, for hosts
  that supply their own `<html>` / `<head>`.
